description: Maps the six research questions from the problem statement to insight types the engine must produce.

research_questions.question: Why do users repeatedly purchase from the same categories?
research_questions.name: Habit drivers
research_questions.description: Recurring reasons users stay in a narrow category set (mental model, reorder convenience, risk aversion).
example_outputs: Users treat the app as emergency snacks only

research_questions.question: What barriers prevent users from trying new products or categories?
research_questions.name: Barrier taxonomy insights
research_questions.description: Ranked, evidenced distribution of barriers blocking cross-category purchase.
example_outputs: Search vocab gap blocks organic discovery

research_questions.question: How do users currently discover products?
research_questions.name: Discovery path map
research_questions.description: How users find products today: search, homepage, categories, recommendations, social, reorder.
example_outputs: Most exploration attempts start in search

research_questions.question: What information do users need before experimenting with a new category?
research_questions.name: Trust / information needs
research_questions.description: Specific information gaps that must close before trial (expiry, origin, reviews, unit price, etc.).
example_outputs: Need visible expiry on dairy PDPs
Want customer photos for produce quality

research_questions.question: Which user segments are most receptive to category exploration?
research_questions.name: Receptive segments
research_questions.description: Language/pattern proxies for users more open to trying new categories.
example_outputs: Health-conscious users ask for organic but cite discovery gaps

research_questions.question: Where should the product intervene to improve cross-category exploration?
research_questions.name: Opportunity briefs
research_questions.description: Actionable barrier × segment × lever recommendations grounded in evidence quotes.
example_outputs: Trial packs + expiry clarity for dairy explorers

theme_guidelines.definition: A theme is a recurring, human-readable claim about user needs or barriers, supported by multiple evidence quotes.
theme_guidelines.naming: Use short noun phrases (e.g. 'Dairy near-expiry anxiety'), not full sentences.
non_themes: Off-topic app bugs unless tied to exploration
